friction_categories.description: Agents opened paths from an older layout and paid a failed read for each one.
examples: [demo-a1] read src/relay/queue.py after the module moved to src/relay/pipeline/queue.py
friction_categories.remediation: Keep the directory map in AGENTS.md current, and tell agents to search before opening a guessed path.
friction_categories.title: Blind path guesses after a move (12 occurrences)

friction_categories.description: Edits failed because the target lines had changed since the agent last read them.
examples: [demo-b2] edit failed on a function that had been renamed two turns earlier
friction_categories.remediation: Read the exact target lines immediately before editing, and never edit from a cached snippet.
friction_categories.title: Stale edit targets (9 occurrences)

key_insight: Work concentrates in two repositories, and the tool-error count follows command retries rather than scope changes.
narrative_paragraphs: Half the window was one repository at a time, with short supervised loops and a test run between turns.
The four long threads all crossed a refactor boundary. Their error counts came from retried shell commands after a moved path, not from scope changes.
